text.p: Secondhand tonnage brokers reported the late sale of the following vessels.
BULKERS - Tohzan - (built 1982) 39,484 dwt sold for $8 million to Greek buyers.
Western Mariner - (built 1984) 42,239 dwt sold for $11.6 million to Turkish buyers.
Prosperous - (built 1990) sold for $25 million including charter to June 1997 at $18,000 daily.
TANKERS - Isola Turchese - (built 1973) 22,707 dwt sold for $2 million.
Sitara - (built 1991) 29,997 dwt sold for approx. $21 million each.
SOLD FOR DEMOLITION - Mare Equatoriale - (built 1964) 20,881 dwt sold for $188 delivery India.
Peggy - (built 1970) 96,676 dwt sold for $197 delivery Bangladesh.
Tampa Bay - (built 1966) sold for $190 "as is" delivery Singapore.
Orantus - (built 1972) 14,436 dwt sold for $177 delivery Bangladesh.
Kaveri - (built 1972) 14,888 dwt sold for $190 for delivery Calcutta.
Cape Monterey - (built 1971) 15,175 dwt sold for $206 delivery India.
Mastrorafalias - (built 1972) 16,500 dwt sold for $200 delivery India.
